title: Provision Stripe API Keys for Development Environment
description:
Stripe test API keys need to be provisioned in the development environment and injected into the secrets manager. Required for Arjun Mehta to begin Stripe integration work on NEX-204.

Raised in standup_01 as a blocker. Resolved by DevOps on Nov 6 — keys now available in AWS Secrets Manager under /nexora/dev/stripe.
